g.text: Incumbent material increases through different spatial changes
All 97 eligible basal checkpoints · explicit normalization to each model's own reference · unchanged native measurements
References: L19 for WP/Goryachev/deBelly; L20 for Holmes; resting L₀=1 for Spring.
Amount is excess activity in the connected basal half-contrast core. Spring widths/amounts use its physical domain; deBelly retains nominal solver coordinates.
Thirteen preparation-ineligible sizes are recorded separately, not assigned zero. Original full native-unit organization artwork remains linked.
